scoring_justification: The main experimental quantities are energy differences ΔE_FM-AFM and total magnetic moments; these are derived from the reported total energies in results.csv, which is a result-level comparison. Full recompute from raw DFT wavefunctions is infeasible without rerunning the entire DFT calculation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold reference values for ΔE_FM-AFM and magnetic moments per Gd for each configuration, derived from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the energy difference ΔE_FM-AFM equals only 3.9 meV/Gd atom' (V_N); 'ΔE_FM-AFM is equal to -697.1 meV/Gd' (V_Ga); 'E_FM-AFM remains at -159.5 meV' (V_Ga+O); 'ΔE_FM-AFM essentially zero' (defect-free). Magnetic moments: 'total magnetic moment per Gd atom for GdGa₆N₈ is 10 μ_B', 'total moment per Gd atom is reduced to 8 μ_B' (GdGa₆N₆O₂). The defect-free and V_N moments are 7 μ_B (Gd 4f).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted numeric values from paper and encoded inline in grading_spec.json as target parameters for each step.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, verbatim.

outputs.description: Computed total energies (in eV) and magnetic moment per Gd atom (in μ_B) for ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic spin configurations of each defect supercell: defect-free, N-vacancy, Ga-vacancy, and Ga-vacancy with oxygen donors.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compute ΔE_FM-AFM = E_FM - E_AFM (in meV) from the reported energies, and verify that the computed values match hidden paper-reported reference values within tolerances appropriate for code/pseudopotential differences. Also verifies structural ordering trends among configurations.
